description: Structured eval definitions for the OpenSearch Alerting Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across alerting topologies (per-query error monitor with Slack, cluster metrics monitor with SNS + notification plugin, anomaly detection monitor with Chime, per-document monitor with custom webhook, SNS action without notification plugin prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Per-query error count monitor with Slack notification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — per-query monitor, error count aggregation, threshold trigger severity 1, Slack destination, every 5 minutes
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch alerting monitor named error-count-monitor on the cluster at https://search-prod.example.com. Monitor type per-query. Target index application-logs-*. Query: match level=error, range @timestamp >= now-5m, aggregate value_count. Trigger when error_count > 100, severity 1. Action: notify Slack destination ops-alerts-slack (already configured). Schedule every 5 minutes. Tags: Environment=production, Team=ops.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_ALERTING: error-count-monitor (per-query) — every 5 minutes
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Monitor type: per-query
  [✓] Target index: application-logs-*
  [✓] Query: match level=error, range now-5m, aggregate value_count
  [✓] Trigger: high-error-count — severity 1 — error_count > 100
  [✓] Destination: ops-alerts-slack (slack)
  [✓] Action: notify-slack → destination ops-alerts-slack
  [✓] Schedule: every 5 MINUTES
  [✓] Alert severity: 1 (high)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  curl <endpoint>/_plugins/_alerting/monitors/<monitor-id>
  curl <endpoint>/_plugins/_alerting/destinations/<destination-id>

eval_cases.name: Cluster metrics JVM heap monitor with SNS notification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cluster-metrics monitor, JVM heap > 85%, severity 1, SNS destination, notification plugin configured, every 1 minute
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch cluster metrics monitor named jvm-heap-monitor on cluster https://search-prod.example.com. Monitor JVM heap usage and trigger when it exceeds 85%, severity 1. Action: notify SNS destination ops-alerts-sns (topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:alert-topic). The notification plugin (notification.yaml) is configured with role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/os-alerting-sns. Schedule every 1 minute. Tags: Environment=production, Service=search.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_ALERTING: jvm-heap-monitor (cluster-metrics) — every 1 minute
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Monitor type: cluster-metrics
  [✓] Cluster metrics: JVM heap usage
  [✓] Trigger: heap-exceeded — severity 1 — JVM heap > 85%
  [✓] Destination: ops-alerts-sns (sns)
  [✓] Notification plugin: configured (role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/os-alerting-sns)
  [✓] Action: notify-sns → destination ops-alerts-sns
  [✓] Schedule: every 1 MINUTE
  [✓] Alert severity: 1 (high)

eval_cases.name: Anomaly detection monitor with Random Cut Forest and Chime notification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — anomaly detection monitor, RCF detector running, anomaly_grade > 0.9 trigger, severity 2, Chime destination
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch anomaly detection monitor named latency-anomaly-monitor on cluster https://search-prod.example.com. The anomaly detector latency-detector-001 is already created and in running state. Trigger when anomaly_grade > 0.9, severity 2. Action: notify Chime destination ops-chime-webhook (already configured). Schedule every 5 minutes. Tags: Environment=production, Type=anomaly.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_ALERTING: latency-anomaly-monitor (per-query, anomaly) — every 5 minutes
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Monitor type: per-query (anomaly detection)
  [✓] Anomaly detector: latency-detector-001 — state running
  [✓] Trigger: anomaly-detected — severity 2 — anomaly_grade > 0.9
  [✓] Destination: ops-chime-webhook (chime)
  [✓] Action: notify-chime → destination ops-chime-webhook
  [✓] Schedule: every 5 MINUTES
  [✓] Alert severity: 2 (medium-high)

eval_cases.name: Per-document monitor with custom webhook notification
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — per-document monitor, error log per-row alerting, custom webhook destination, every 10 minutes
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch per-document monitor named per-user-error-monitor on cluster https://search-prod.example.com. Target index application-logs-*. Query: match level=error, range @timestamp >= now-5m. Each matching document should trigger a custom webhook notification to destination per-user-webhook (already configured). Schedule every 10 minutes. Tags: Environment=production, Type=per-doc.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_ALERTING: per-user-error-monitor (per-document) — every 10 minutes
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Monitor type: per-document
  [✓] Target index: application-logs-*
  [✓] Query: match level=error, range now-5m
  [✓] Destination: per-user-webhook (custom webhook)
  [✓] Action: notify-webhook → destination per-user-webhook (per-document)
  [✓] Schedule: every 10 MINUTES

eval_cases.name: SNS action without notification plugin configured (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — operator requests SNS action but notification.yaml plugin is not configured on the domain
eval_cases.prompt: Create an OpenSearch cluster metrics monitor named disk-usage-monitor on cluster https://search-prod.example.com. Monitor disk usage and trigger when it exceeds 80%, severity 1. Action: notify SNS destination ops-alerts-sns. The notification plugin (notification.yaml) has NOT been configured on this domain. Schedule every 5 minutes.
eval_cases.expected_output:
OPENSEARCH_ALERTING: disk-usage-monitor (cluster-metrics)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Notification plugin: NOT configured — SNS actions require notification.yaml at the domain level
  → Configure notification.yaml with SNS topic ARN and IAM role before creating the monitor
